title: WaterColor 22 Wiregrass Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in a quiet location in the WaterColor Lake District- Access to WaterColor community pools- Minutes from Frog Pool and directly across from Long Leaf Park- Stainless steel kitchen appliances- 2 dedicated parking spots with additional parking throughout the community- 5 adult bikes- Gas grill- Porch swings- 3 Screened-in Porches- Theatre room- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Luxury and privacy make this breathtaking WaterColor home the perfect place for your next 30A getaway. This home presents 5 bedrooms, 5 full bathrooms, 2 half-bathrooms, and wonderful accommodations for 12 guests.Neutral interiors create a soft and welcoming glow for guests arriving in this incredible home. The first floor features a spacious open floor plan between the kitchen, dining, and living areas. Guests will love relaxing in the cozy living room, which features coffered ceilings, 2 sofas, plush armchairs, and a large mounted flat-screen television. The nearby dining area offers seating for 8 guests, with additional seating at the breakfast bar. This home's gourmet kitchen boasts premium stainless steel appliances, bright white custom cabinetry, and granite countertops. Also on the first floor is one of the home's 2 primary bedrooms. This guest room offers a luxurious king bed and a private bathroom with a shower only.The second floor offers a variety of guest room accommodations. The first room features a queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Two built-in twin-over-twin bunk beds and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo create a perfect space for kids in the bunk room. On this level, the final bedroom is a gorgeous primary suite with a plush king bed and a private bathroom with a soaking tub and a shower.Guests will love the home's third-floor theater room, which boasts an oversized cozy sectional sofa, a large flat-screen television, and a half bath - a perfect place to enjoy a vacation movie night and snacks with loved ones! This home also features multiple screened porches, welcoming guests to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of idyllic WaterColor. Just across the street are Long Leaf Park and WaterColor's famous community pools.The carriage house offers a perfect setup for guests seeking a little more privacy. This space features a living area with a mounted flat-screen television, a queen sleeper sofa, a bedroom with a queen bed and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo, and a kitchenette with a full-size refrigerator/freezer, sink, and microwave.Your dream WaterColor getaway is just a few clicks away. Book your stay at 22 Wiregrass Way today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom Separate Shower, and Tub - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: Queen Sleeper Sofa, Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom Shower/Tub Combo* Unfortunately, this home does not allow pets at any time.
